meta.title: Wishful Autonomous Bioinformatics Platform
meta.description: One sentence in, frozen plan, immutable run, evidence package: one gateway over the single-cell, bulk, plotting, virtual-cell, spatial and metabolomics workbenches, with five-source search, unified downloads, harmonization and joint analysis, delivering traceable manifest/design/qc/results/figures/evidence/methods.

title: Wishful Autonomous Bioinformatics Platform
subtitle: Wish · frozen plan · immutable run · evidence package
wish_placeholder: Plain words are fine, e.g. "take the gastric cancer liver metastases in GSE84433, compare NK proportions against primary, and plot it"
empty_plan: No plan yet: describe what you need at the lower left and you will get an editable draft plan card
empty_pipeline: No pipeline yet: once a plan is confirmed and submitted, each step appears here as it runs
empty_sources: No search results yet: search a GSE, TCGA project, MTBLS accession or keywords
empty_downloads: No downloads yet: select records in the search results and add them to downloads
empty_artifacts: No artifacts yet: a successful run produces manifest / design / qc / results / figures / evidence / methods
empty_evidence: No evidence records yet: every claim of a successful run binds run_id / table_id / row_id
